The '''BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax''' was a sophisticated melee weapon produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]]. The axe was favored by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guards.

==Description==
The BD-1 Cutter was a model of [[Vibro-ax/Legends|Vibro-ax]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The weapon consisted of a long, hollow [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] shaft topped by a high-powered [[Axe/Legends|axe]] head. The [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic generator]] and [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] were located in the axe head and gave the blade enough power to slice through [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating. A quick-release switch allowed the wielder to switch out a damaged blade in a matter of [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The axe head had an intensity setting that allowed the wielder to determine how much damage the blade dealt to an enemy. The durasteel shaft was gitted with [[internal dampener]]s that were designed to absorb the vibrations generated by the axe head. The weapon's power cells allowed for six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of constant operation.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] warriors favored the use of BD-1 Cutter vibro-axs.<ref name="EGWT" /> One was used to prod [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] into the mouth of the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].
